questions.question: What returned to the temple in Ezekiel 43?
options: A great army, marching from the north
The glory of the LORD, entering by the east gate
The ark of the covenant, carried in by the priests
A river of life, flowing from the altar
questions.answer: The glory of the LORD, entering by the east gate

questions.question: What did God call the temple in Ezekiel 43?
options: A house of prayer where all of the many nations of the whole earth would gather together
A great memorial built up to honor all of the kings of the royal house of David
A strong and mighty fortress to stand firm against all the surrounding hostile peoples
The place of his throne and the place of the soles of his feet, where he will dwell forever
questions.answer: The place of his throne and the place of the soles of his feet, where he will dwell forever

questions.question: Ezekiel 43 also gives instructions for the altar and its offerings.
